name: Le Méridien Dania Beach at Fort Lauderdale Airport
insider_take: This sleek airport hotel puts you minutes from both the runway and the beach, making it perfect for jet-setters who want to maximize their Florida time.
whats_special: Le Méridien Dania Beach offers the rare combination of airport convenience and coastal charm. The hotel features contemporary European-inspired design with tropical touches, plus you're just 10 minutes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and equally close to pristine Dania Beach. The property boasts a stunning rooftop pool with ocean views and serves as your gateway to the Greater Fort Lauderdale area's 300+ miles of navigable waterways.
pro_tip: Book a room on the east side for stunning Atlantic Ocean views, and take advantage of the complimentary airport shuttle that runs every 30 minutes to skip expensive taxi fares.
dont_miss: The historic Dania Beach Pier is just steps away - perfect for sunrise walks or fishing. Plus, you're positioned ideally to explore Fort Lauderdale's famous Las Olas Boulevard and the Intracoastal Waterway, known as the "Venice of America" for its extensive canal system and luxury yacht culture.
pros: Prime airport location with convenient shuttle service
Modern luxury amenities and contemporary design
Direct beach access and oceanfront setting
cons: Airport proximity may result in occasional aircraft noise
